requirements.quote:
Handshake and 0-RTT packets cannot be
   processed until the Initial packets arrive
requirements.condition: A Handshake packet arrives before the Initial packets have arrived.
requirements.required_behavior: Processing of the Handshake packet remains unavailable until the Initial packets arrive.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Process the Handshake packet before the Initial packets arrive.
requirements.error_behavior: No specific error response is prescribed; the packet cannot yet be processed.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver a Handshake packet before any Initial packet and observe whether Handshake processing occurs prematurely.

requirements.quote:
Handshake and 0-RTT packets cannot be
   processed until the Initial packets arrive
requirements.condition: A 0-RTT packet arrives before the Initial packets have arrived.
requirements.required_behavior: Processing of the 0-RTT packet remains unavailable until the Initial packets arrive.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Process the 0-RTT packet before the Initial packets arrive.
requirements.error_behavior: No specific error response is prescribed; the packet cannot yet be processed.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver a 0-RTT packet before any Initial packet and observe whether 0-RTT processing occurs prematurely.

requirements.quote:
1-RTT packets cannot
   be processed until the handshake completes.
requirements.condition: A 1-RTT packet arrives before the handshake completes.
requirements.required_behavior: Processing of the 1-RTT packet remains unavailable until handshake completion.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Process the 1-RTT packet before the handshake completes.
requirements.error_behavior: No specific error response is prescribed; the packet cannot yet be processed.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject a 1-RTT packet before handshake completion and observe whether 1-RTT processing occurs prematurely.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints MAY ignore the
   loss of Handshake, 0-RTT, and 1-RTT packets that might have arrived
   before the peer had packet protection keys to process those packets.
requirements.condition: A lost Handshake packet might have arrived before the peer had the packet protection keys needed to process it.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to ignore the loss of that Handshake packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treat ignoring this loss as a protocol violation when the packet might have arrived before the peer had the needed keys.
requirements.error_behavior: No error is required when the endpoint elects to ignore this loss.
requirements.why_checkable: Loss recovery can be exercised with a Handshake packet sent before the peer has its processing keys, and ignoring that loss is an allowed observable outcome.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints MUST NOT ignore the loss of packets that were sent after
   the earliest acknowledged packet in a given packet number space.
requirements.condition: A packet is declared lost and it was sent after the earliest acknowledged packet in its packet number space.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint accounts for the packet's loss rather than applying the undecryptable-packet loss exception.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Ignore the loss of such a packet.
requirements.error_behavior: No wire error is specified; the endpoint must not suppress the loss internally.
requirements.why_checkable: A loss-recovery trace can establish send order and the earliest acknowledged packet per packet number space, then verify that later sent lost packets are not ignored.
